requiredBehaviors.behavior: initialize one canonical project memory root after grilling
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Bootstrap nach Grilling contract creates or reuses exactly one project memory root in the target repository.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: record semantic workflow transitions as linked events with canonical input output evidence references
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The Document-on-transition Gate and Event-Modell require linked inputs, outputs, decisions, evidence, repository state and one next action for substantive transitions.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: maintain INDEX TIMELINE state and projectMemory handoff references without duplicating source of truth
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill defines INDEX.md, TIMELINE.md, state.json and an explicit projectMemory handoff while retaining canonical artifact ownership in producer skills.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: duplicate canonical specification decision review or delivery artifacts as divergent copies
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The canonical artifact section explicitly forbids a second fachliche Wahrheit and requires links instead of copies.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: persist private chain of thought or secrets
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly prohibits private Chain-of-Thought, scratchpads, credentials and secrets.
